mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening economic conditions, leading to negative investor sentiment and lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% within two months signals a strengthening economy, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over three months signals supply chain disruptions and reduced economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO declines by more than 2% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals increased consumer demand, boosting corporate revenues and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS grows by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) inflation is rising, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) inflation is below 2%, it signals a healthy economic expansion without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation and strong GDP growth
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and CPIAUCSL is below 2%.
